Making Johnny Depps top Hat from Ebenezer. It's great to see @johnnydepp back in action for a major production and I think the character of Scrooge is absolutely perfect for Depp to explore and the quirks and magic that he always brings. Making a hat like this requires a hatter to have mastered many different aspects of hat making  Getting the felt formed over the 18cm tall hat block is a wrestle with a stiff western weight fur felt such as this one. Creating the special d' orsay brim edge curl and binding is the most time consuming and difficult part of making these as the curl is flattened back on it self and then the brim edge binding has to be sewn on in a particular way to achieve the desired finish. This part alone is a whole days work. While the Victorians would have been wearing silk plush top hats this one is made in a rabbit fur felt with a long hair felt that mimicks silk plush. The trade for manufacturing silk top hats is almost completely extinct and most silk hats worn these days are antiques which have been refurbished and fitted by specialist hatters such as @ascottophats.
